findings.title: iam_wait.tf still depends on deleted backend_secret_access; per-secret grants not in propagation chain
findings.explanation: time_sleep.iam_propagation was created to delay Cloud Run startup until IAM bindings propagate. It still lists google_project_iam_member.backend_secret_access in its depends_on — a resource that no longer exists after replacing the project-level grant with per-secret google_secret_manager_secret_iam_member.backend_access bindings. On a fresh tofu apply, the propagation sleep will not wait for the new per-secret IAM grants, meaning Cloud Run may start before the secret accessor bindings have propagated and fail to read any of the six secrets on first boot. A rules engine cannot detect a depends_on reference to a deleted resource.
findings.remediation: Replace google_project_iam_member.backend_secret_access in the depends_on list of time_sleep.iam_propagation with google_secret_manager_secret_iam_member.backend_access (the for_each resource). Also remove the reference to the deleted resource to avoid a plan error.
